title: The Clayoquot Sound Theatre

services.name: Monday Night Movies
services.desc: A wide variety of movies are screened on Mondays throughout the year, from blockbusters to documentaries, foreign films to arthouse. There are generally no showings on stat holidays. Visit https://tofinomovies.blogspot.com or our Facebook page Monday Night Movies in Tofino for current information. All movies are screened at 7:30pm at Clayoquot Sound Theatre, 380 Campbell St, Tofino, across from the Village Green. Doors and snacks open at 6:45 pm and close at 7:30. No other food or drink (aside from water) are permitted in the Theatre. Thank you! See you at the movies! services.name: venue rentals
services.desc: The theatre can be rented individuals and groups. We are flexible and will try to accommodate unusual requests. We are sympathetic to good causes, but as a non-profit ourselves we must cover our costs. First, contact the Theatre Manager (below). Tell her your needs and she will advise you on fees, and email you the Theatre Rental contract for you to fill out, sign, and return. When you get to Tofino, she will familiarize you with the workings of the theatre and help make your experience a positive one. Our manager is Sophie L’Homme - tofinotheatre@gmail.com.
